To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
thyroid hormone regulates the glucose transporter protein in astrocytes.
thyroid hormone is essential for the normal expression of the glucose transporter in astrocytes and that the glucose transporter is a major target for the actions of this hormone in the brain.

1) Thyroid hormone is a potent regulator of glucose transport in astrocytes, 2) Thyroid hormone increases the number of glucose transporter molecules in the plasma membrane, 3) Thyroid hormone does not increase the affinity of astrocytic glucose transporters for glucose, 4) Astrocytes express two types of glucose transporters, one of which is regulated by thyroid hormone, and 5) Astrocytes are the only brain cells that express this type of glucose transporter
In summary, our research is concerned with
the regulation of glucose transport in the brain.
the role of thyroid hormone in the regulation of glucose transport in brain.
the role of thyroid hormones on the transport of glucose in astrocytes and the mechanism by which these hormones exert this effect.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
thyroid hormone is an important factor in the regulation of glucose transport in brain cells.
thyroid hormones regulate the expression of the GLUT1 gene in brain astrocytes and that the regulation of GLUT1 is a major mechanism of thyroid hormones on glucose metabolism in brain.
thyroid hormone is required for the maintenance of a normal level of glucose transport in brain cells.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
thyroid hormone regulates glucose transport in astrocytes, and that the effect is exerted on a high‐affinity system.
astrocytes are a major site for thyroid hormone regulation of glucose uptake in brain.
thyroid hormones regulate glucose transport in brain astrocytes by modulating the number of glucose transporter proteins (GLUT) in the plasma membrane.
The main takeaway from our work is that
thyroid hormone plays a role in the transport of sugars into the cell.
thyroid hormone plays a key role in the regulation of glucose transport across plasma membranes of astrocytes and other cell types.
thyroid hormone is a key regulator of glucose transport in brain cells.
